executive_summary: Sixteenth consecutive week of complete failure with zero trades and zero P&L. The Supply & Demand Zone strategy is irrecoverably broken and has not produced a single trade in approximately four months. Parameter tuning within this framework is futile — the strategy architecture itself must be replaced entirely. Continuing to run this system is equivalent to running no system at all. The only actionable path forward is deploying a fundamentally different strategy engine.
target_progress: 0% — 70% below 70% target. No progress possible with current architecture.
regime_assessment: Regime detection is technically functional (correctly identifying trending_up and trending_down across 7 days), but it is entirely irrelevant because the strategy layer never generates signals regardless of regime. There is zero evidence regime detection helps or hurts because there are zero trades to evaluate against.

symbol_changes.remove_reason: No symbol-level data exists. Zero trades across all symbols for 16 weeks makes symbol-level analysis impossible.
symbol_changes.focus_reason: Cannot identify winning symbols when no trades have been taken. Symbol selection is not the bottleneck — strategy signal generation is.

dow_pattern: No day-of-week pattern can be identified. Zero trades on every day of the week for 16 consecutive weeks. Day-of-week optimization is meaningless until the system can actually generate trades.

param_search_adjustments.reasoning: LAST ATTEMPT before full strategy replacement: aggressively lower min_score from 75 to 40-65 range and reduce RR ratio to 1.0-1.8. The current min_score of 75 with RR of 2.0 is filtering out 100% of potential signals. However, this is likely insufficient — the core zone detection algorithm itself appears unable to identify valid zones in current market conditions. If this produces zero trades again, parameter adjustment must be permanently abandoned.

structural_recommendations.change: REPLACE the Supply & Demand Zone strategy entirely with a momentum/breakout strategy (e.g., ORB — Opening Range Breakout, or VWAP mean-reversion). The S&D zone engine has produced zero trades for 16 weeks across all market regimes and all parameter combinations attempted. It is architecturally incapable of generating signals.
structural_recommendations.expected_impact: Moving from 0 trades/week to 3-8 trades/week. Even a naive breakout strategy with 45% win rate would massively outperform current zero-trade state. Expected P&L improvement from ₹0 to positive territory.

structural_recommendations.change: Implement a MINIMUM TRADE GUARANTEE circuit breaker: if zero trades are generated by midweek (Wednesday close), automatically switch to a fallback strategy with relaxed entry criteria (e.g., simple EMA crossover with ATR-based stops). The system must never go an entire week without trading again.
structural_recommendations.expected_impact: Guarantees minimum 1-2 trades per week, providing actual performance data to optimize against. Eliminates the 16-week data void problem.

structural_recommendations.change: Add a SIGNAL AUDIT LOG that records every potential zone identified, why it was scored below threshold, and what score it received. Currently operating completely blind — we cannot diagnose whether zones are being found but rejected, or not found at all.
structural_recommendations.expected_impact: Enables root cause diagnosis within 1 week instead of blind parameter guessing. Critical for any future strategy tuning.

structural_recommendations.change: Implement multi-strategy portfolio: run 2-3 uncorrelated strategies simultaneously (e.g., momentum breakout for trending regimes, mean-reversion for ranging regimes, and optionally S&D zones as a supplementary signal). Route capital based on regime detection output.
structural_recommendations.expected_impact: Diversifies signal sources, ensures trades are generated across all market regimes. Expected to produce 5-15 trades/week with blended 50-60% win rate.

primary_strategy_next_week: Opening Range Breakout (ORB) or VWAP Breakout — NOT Supply & Demand Zones
